text: New page: the authorization bubble, ATO or IATT; six subsystems inside, F-16 Block 70 and the facility left, interconnections right, interfaces drawn across the line.
The IATT covers Increment 2's test configuration: Block 1.1 changes per subsystem, flight test instrumentation inside, the test range outside, SIPRNet not connected.
One table under the bubble: element or system, inside or outside, what covers it, and who is responsible; every row opens its preview.
New Host & providers page: each provider's offer and what WS-X90 takes (Offered, Inherited, Hybrid, Taken back), its authorization and expiry.
The inheritance table lists 76 controls from providers, host first, with quick views and Provider and Family filters; rows open the control preview.
Change responsibility, one row or several: Inherited, Hybrid (WS-X90's part required) or System-specific, with a reason; it says what each status becomes.
Add provider: the workspace's providers WS-X90 doesn't take from, what each offers, and that its controls become inherited by default.
Provider preview: owner, authorization, expiry, what it offers, what WS-X90 takes, its interfaces and the programs it carries; ↗ opens its page.
New page for F-16 Block 70: its offered controls (CRM), what it carries (WS-X90, Customer A), its interfaces and its authorization.
New pages for the Squadron operations facility and the C-130J, lighter: the facility's POA&M item holds PE-15, which WS-X90 inherits as it is.
Responsibility column (Inherited, Hybrid or System-specific, with the provider) and a working Responsibility filter that lists the baseline's controls by it.
Counts follow inheritance: 227 of 560 satisfied, 52 inherited, Needs evidence 185, Not assessed 86, Short of satisfied 48.
A Responsibility fact names the provider; an inherited control's card is the provider's statement and authorization, in place of requirements and evidence.
A control's page: Responsibility fact, the provider's statement on Implementation, no next step for WS-X90, Change responsibility in its ⋯.
SI-2's page gains the Responsibility fact (System-specific) and Change responsibility in its ⋯.
Details rail: Host system F-16 Block 70 (opens its preview); the completion card reads 227 of 560 controls · 52 inherited.
WS-X90's card reads 41%, 227 of 560 controls satisfied: the controls it inherits read their providers' status.
WS-X90's row reads 41%, 227 of 560; its preview's control status counts follow too.
The status strip counts with inheritance (Satisfied 227) and the heading says 18 families · 52 inherited.
An inherited control shows its provider's statement and needs no narrative; a hybrid one shows the provider's part above WS-X90's narrative.
Appendix A lists every control a provider holds, host first; the control status bar counts 227 satisfied; Assist answers who WS-X90 inherits from.
SCTM and Controls sheets gain Responsibility and Provider columns; inherited rows read Inherited where a requirement or evidence would be.
Analysis counts by responsibility (Inherited 52, 51 satisfied; Hybrid 24; System-specific 484) as live formulas; Mapped no longer counts inherited rows.
F-16 Block 70 and the Squadron operations facility join the elements and sources WS-X90 inherits from; their inherited controls decide status.
A From the host and facility quick view lists their controls with the provider's status; the counts include them.
Package tab rail: What it covers, the bubble drawn small (Increment 1 · Block 1, six subsystems, what stays outside), linking to Boundary.
The Systems step asks for the host system (None, F-16 Block 70, C-130J) and says how many controls it offers, inherited by default.
The Baseline step says how many of the chosen baseline's controls are inherited from the host by default; the review lists it.
A created program's Boundary and Host & providers pages show the host chosen and what it inherits by default.
Settings lists the host systems with the providers: what each offers, which programs inherit from it, its authorization; rows open the provider preview.
The control status trend counts with inheritance: 227 of 560 today, each daily snapshot moved by what inheriting moves.
The daily snapshots read 227 of 560 controls satisfied, as the snapshots taken with inheritance would.
A changed row says so; its reason, who and when are kept and shown on the control's preview and page beside the provider's still-standing offer.
The launcher's answers count with inheritance too: 185 controls have no evidence (was 233).
Objectives assessed counts the providers' assessments of inherited controls: 970 of 1,791.
WS-X90's program preview counts 41% satisfied: Satisfied 227, Partially 35, Not assessed 86, No evidence 185.

Every place WS-X90's control totals show reads one number (227 of 560, 52 inherited): Home, Programs and its preview, Overview, Controls, Baseline, SSP editor, SCTM and Analysis, the trend, the event log, the launcher.
